description: Curated control rows for data/control-points.json (PRD-SETPOINT-SIM B1). HAND-WRITTEN and reviewed. tools/build-control-registry.mjs reads it. A setpoint here names the engine parameter that holds it; its value, source and evidence class come from the engine registry, never from this file. `adjustable` exists only with a written basis.

convSetpoints.label: Chilled water supply setpoint
convSetpoints.control: leaving chilled water temperature held by the chiller capacity control; the engine derives it from the CRAH supply air less the coil approach
convSetpoints.adjustableNote: derived: it moves when its drivers move (rack-inlet target, coil approach), never on its own

convSetpoints.label: CRAH supply air setpoint
convSetpoints.control: supply air temperature held by the CRAH chilled-water valve; the engine sets it equal to the rack-inlet target (no bypass or recirculation modelled)

convSetpoints.label: Rack inlet temperature target
convSetpoints.control: the cold-aisle condition the air system is designed and reset to

adjustable.basis: ASHRAE TC9.9 Thermal Guidelines (5th ed.), class A1 recommended envelope 18–27 °C
adjustable.stepBasis: 0.1 K, the resolution the engine parameter is stated in (25.4 °C)

convSetpoints.whatIfNote: Steady state of the engine: the rack inlet target resets the CRAH supply air and the CHW supply that follow it. PUE is a model input (site.pue) in this engine, so no setpoint moves it. Dynamics (how fast the plant gets there) are not modelled.

convSetpoints.label: Condenser water supply setpoint
convSetpoints.control: tower leaving water temperature held by the tower fan speed
convSetpoints.adjustableNote: no floor is declared yet: the lowest reachable value is the design wet-bulb plus the tower approach, and the chiller's minimum lift; adjustable when both are in the engine

convSetpoints.label: Secondary loop differential pressure setpoint
convSetpoints.control: remote differential pressure held by the secondary pump speed

adjustable.basis: the chiller-plant page's DP setpoint range (60–140 kPa), the range the engine parameter states as its source

whatIf.label: Secondary pump input power, running fleet

convSetpoints.whatIfNote: Steady state of the engine: the pump speed its curve needs to hold this differential pressure, and the input power at that operating head (engine 2.10.0). The loop flow is set by the load, not by this setpoint, so the power moves little. PUE is a model input and does not move. Dynamics are not modelled.

dcaiValueEvidence.note: A DC AI point record that TYPES its reference value (sp.value in js/datahall-ai/points.js) has no source for that number of its own: it is ASSUMED unless listed here with the reason.

sld-mv-sub/bus_kv.why: 20 kV is the nominal system voltage (IEC 60038 / SPLN 1)

sld-rmu/bus_kv.why: 20 kV is the nominal system voltage (IEC 60038 / SPLN 1)

sld-mv-sub/frequency.why: 50 Hz is the nominal frequency of the PLN grid (Grid Code Jawa-Madura-Bali)

rack-busbar/vdc.why: 48 VDC is the shelf output voltage of the rack power design

chem/ph.why: the page's own control window 8.2–8.8; 8.5 is its centre

dcaiPlaneController.note: Which DC AI point class HOLDS each engine design plane (its controller acts on it). On that class the plane is a setpoint; on every other class that reads the same plane it is a reference, with heldBy naming the controller. A plane with no controller among the DC AI point classes is a reference everywhere.

p07_tcs_supply_c.why: the CDU holds TCS supply with its HX control valve

p02_dry_cooler_leaving_c.why: the dry cooler holds its leaving water with fan speed

p12_chw_supply_c.why: the chiller holds leaving chilled water with its capacity control

p09_air_supply_c.why: the CRAH holds supply air with its chilled-water valve

dcaiTypedSetpoints.note: DC AI point records whose typed value IS a control setpoint (a controller holds it); every other typed value is a reference (nameplate, nominal, design value).
dcaiTypedSetpoints.crah/supply_rh: humidity setpoint of the CRAH humidifier / dehumidification control
dcaiTypedSetpoints.chem/ph: pH control point of the dosing controller
dcaiTypedSetpoints.chem/conductivity: conductivity setpoint of the blowdown controller
dcaiTypedSetpoints.chem/orp: ORP control point of the biocide dosing
dcaiTypedSetpoints.chem/inhibitor_ppm: inhibitor residual target of the dosing controller
